description: Measure ratios, uncertainty and editable geometry from one face. Costs 25 credits; do not call in a loop. needs-review without grade ceilings is expected. If corners are wrong, ask the person to correct them and measure again. Grade ceilings follow a person checking or moving the lines in the app (confirm is deliberately not an MCP tool), or known ratios via ptcg_grade_centering. Never claim an assistant checked the lines on behalf of a person. Growth and higher; Developer excluded. Verified Free trial: 5 measure and 5 confirm calls independently; grade and standards have no separate trial call counter. Always display: ceiling from centering alone, not a prediction of the final grade. Never call results verified or certified. If the result carries next_step, show its handoff sentence and URL to the user verbatim and do not retry.

corners.description: Optional TL, TR, BR, BL points in EXIF-oriented image pixels reduced to longest edge <=2560 px. Do not invent corrections.

image_base64.description: Photo bytes as base64, optionally a data URL. Entire API body <=10 MiB; single-frame image <=40 MP.
